title: Neurodivergent Influenceability as a Contingent Solution to the AI Alignment Problem
reasoning: The paper centers on evaluating AI alignment through ethical metrics such as 'Ethical Soundness' and 'Ethical Assessment.' Its experimental design specifically uses a human agent expert in AI ethics and philosophy to challenge the moral boundaries and value systems of various LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Claude 3.5, etc.) on controversial ethical topics.
